frozen_polytonic_policy.purpose: Review flag only; no automatic witness selection or corpus text changes.

detector.flag_when: either mark rate is below its minimum on an applicable page

truth_label.label_when: accent or breathing recall below the threshold on matching base-letter positions

frozen_polytonic_policy.selection_policy: No model or reading is selected. All raw predictions, failed pages, false positives and missed cases remain in the report.
operating_limits: Counts alone cannot distinguish damaged polytonic text from intentional monotonic or all-capital orthography.
Sparse pages and pages with too little base-letter alignment need a source review rather than a diacritic-loss label.
Character-level reference order is checked separately; text-order errors are not diacritic loss.
This fixed sample is bounded by the available editions and does not establish corpus-wide error rates.

exploratory_apparatus_policy: At least two Latin words containing a lowercase letter, each at least three letters. This post-inference screen only locates cases for source inspection; it has no measured sensitivity and never changes text.
